guide.title: Purpose
guide.text: Estimate the full 3-year cost of operating an AI workflow, not ROI or a vendor quote.

guide.title: Inputs
guide.text: Blue cells only. All numbers are illustrative and should be replaced with your assumptions.

guide.title: Horizon
guide.text: Fixed three-year model. There is no unused planning-horizon input.

guide.title: Successful outcomes
guide.text: First-pass successes plus recovered failures; unrecovered failures excluded.

guide.title: Rework
guide.text: Recovery defaults to an illustrative 80%. Rework cost is assumed to include all incremental remediation (including extra tokens and review); replace with observed task-level cost.

guide.title: Inflation
guide.text: Annual token price change is a user-selected scenario (0% default); annual inflation applies to labor, rework and fixed monthly costs.

guide.title: Scaling
guide.text: Yes toggles apply a linear volume factor in addition to inflation; No applies inflation alone.

guide.title: Discounting
guide.text: Upfront spend is at t=0; each year's operating costs are discounted at year-end.

guide.title: Human-only baseline
guide.text: Human-only baseline is OFF by default (0 minutes). Only enable after checking comparable quality and scope. Headline TCO is independent of this optional scenario.

guide.title: Comparability
guide.text: AI and manual outcomes must be comparable before treating cost advantage as financial savings.

guide.title: Currencies
guide.text: Currency dropdown is a display unit, not an FX converter; enter all amounts in one currency.

guide.title: Scope
guide.text: Does not automatically include taxes, working capital, opportunity cost, carbon or regulatory impacts.

guide.title: Source
guide.text: All starting inputs are hypothetical AInternals examples; model pricing must be verified externally.

guide.title: Discounted comparison
guide.text: Both AI and human operating costs are discounted at year-end; AI upfront spend is counted at t=0. PV cost advantage is shown separately from nominal advantage.

guide.title: Price provenance
guide.text: Default $2/$10 per million token prices are illustrative placeholders, not attributed to a specific model or verified date. Enter source/model/date on Inputs before publishing scenario results.

guide.title: Editable cells
guide.text: Blue cells on Inputs are intended for editing. Do not edit formulas on the model or dashboard.
